case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the hotel's cleanliness, central location, comfortable beds and breakfast; several reviews also commended friendly staff and flexible/late check-in. Recurring negatives included traffic noise in some rooms and limited in-room storage; a few guests mentioned lack of drying space for towels/swimsuits. Breakfast quality was described both as hearty and as somewhat limited by different reviewers. Isolated comments noted small beds for a larger guest and limited parking.
